_comment: Trace-product bands (2026-10-20): the traces of configs/bands.json (E_K,r <- z_r E_K,r + gamma_r k~, E_V,r <- z_r E_V,r + gamma_r v; R = 4, initial periods 2, 6, 20, 64 blocks with |z| = e^{-1/p}) and no W or eta: M = sum_r gamma_r Re(c_r P_r), P_r = sum_t E_V,r conj(E_K,r)^T, read = q~ (sum_t v k~^T + M)^T (tonic Hebb at gain 1 kept); one complex c_r per head and band (std 0.1 per component). Equivalence: M is the bands model's W with a = conj(c), b = c and a per-band EMA of S at rate 1 - |z_r|^2 instead of the shared learned eta (identical when every |z_r|^2 = 1 - eta). Comparison target: docs/evidence/run_bands/.
